item.title: Use Oura sauna tags in Personal Patterns
item.summary: Murph now syncs dated Oura sauna tags so repeated sauna entries can become Personal Patterns factors.
item.details: Wearable tags stay neutral notes. Personal Patterns currently treats only Oura's exact sauna tag as an action; symptoms, context, custom tags, and tags from other sources stay neutral. Existing Oura tag history receives one bounded refresh under the corrected meaning. Murph does not retain or analyze the provider's free-text note value.
